title: Floor & Decor Announces First Store Opening in Raleigh, NC

# Floor & Decor Announces First Store Opening in Raleigh, NC


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_6c9b80211d227cfa93b44b8fdee7ccc7/flooranddecor/news/2026-10-15_Floor_Decor_Announces_First_Store_Opening_in_306.pdf) October 15, 2026 8:35am EDT


*— Leading specialty retailer of hard-surface flooring brings its expansive in-stock selection and warehouse-format shopping experience to Raleigh for the first time—*


ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Floor & Decor (NYSE: FND), a leading specialty retailer of hard-surface flooring for professionals and homeowners, today announced the opening of its first warehouse store and design center in Raleigh, North Carolina, located at 3131 Capital Blvd.


The Raleigh store opens with a team of approximately 50 associates and is led by Jackie Wint, the store’s Chief Executive Merchant.


Floor & Decor operates more than 280 warehouse-format stores and five design studios nationwide and offers a broad assortment of in-stock hard-surface flooring, including tile, wood, laminate, vinyl, and natural stone, along with decorative accessories and wall tile, installation materials, and related categories at everyday low prices.


“Opening Floor & Decor’s first store in Raleigh is an exciting milestone for our team,” said Wint. “For more than 25 years, Floor & Decor has focused on making quality, trend-forward hard-surface flooring accessible to everyone, and we’re proud to bring that commitment to the Raleigh community. We look forward to serving our new customers and helping bring their ideas to life.”


**Grand Opening Celebration** Floor & Decor will open the doors of its new Raleigh store to customers on Thursday, October 15, 2026, ahead of the official grand opening celebration on Thursday, November 5, 2026, with a full day of events for homeowners and professionals.


**Ribbon Cutting Ceremony** Floor & Decor will host a Ribbon Cutting Ceremony on Thursday, November 5, at 10 a.m. ET, in partnership with the Greater Raleigh Chamber of Commerce.


**PRO Grand Opening Event** That evening, from 5 to 8 p.m. ET, the store will host a PRO Grand Opening Event for local contractors, installers, designers, and other trade professionals. Attendees will have the chance to win a 2026 Chevrolet Colorado.


Store Facts & Features


- Location: 3131 Capital Blvd, Raleigh, NC 27604
- Store Hours: Monday–Friday 7 a.m.–8 p.m.; Saturday 8 a.m.–7 p.m.; Sunday 10 a.m.–6 p.m. ET
- Phone Number: (919) 999-2028


For more information on the PRO Grand Opening events and resources, visit:[www.prograndopening.com/raleighpro](http://www.prograndopening.com/raleighpro) .


**About Floor & Decor Holdings, Inc.** Floor & Decor is a multi-channel specialty retailer of hard-surface flooring and related accessories and seller of commercial surfaces. As of June 25, 2026, the Company operated 281 warehouse-format stores and five design studios across 39 states. The Company offers a broad in-stock assortment of laminate and vinyl, tile, wood, and natural stone flooring and installation materials and decorative accessories, as well as adjacent categories, at everyday low prices. The Company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
